products.name: Facène
products.shortDescription:
The Facène announces itself through its angles. Where most nightstands round off or square up, the Facène cuts a diagonal — its front face angled deliberately, the corners chamfered into a form that feels considered from every position in the room. The body is finished in a smooth grey paint throughout, the leathered maple brown marble top sitting inset above — warm, textured, its surface catching light differently to the matte body beneath.

A single drawer opens from the front. Inside, grey melamine lines the interior cleanly.
Understated until you look closely. Then impossible to overlook.

products.name: Calmène
products.shortDescription:
Rounded at every corner, the Calmène nightstand has the solidity of something carved rather than assembled. The body is wrapped entirely in light grey elm veneer — the grain swirling naturally across each drawer front, the arched base cutout lifting the piece just enough to feel light despite its generous proportions. Two drawers sit flush, their finger pulls carved directly into the wood in a gentle wave. Above, a slab of Caledonia marble with resin fill caps the whole piece- white stone and softly veined.

Inside, grey melamine lines every drawer. Brushed copper stainless steel hardware adds a quiet warmth at the detail level.

A nightstand that rewards the closest look

products.name: Ovarne
products.description: The Ovarne nightstand wraps around itself in a continuous brass metallic shell — straight grain, warm, curving from back to front without a hard edge in sight. Above, a circle of matte silver grey travertine sits flush at the top, cool against the warmth of the metal. Two drawer fronts in dark grey matte elm veneer slide between the brass panels, the grain of the wood swirling naturally across each face. Inside, smoky melamine lines every drawer.
products.shortDescription: The Ovarne nightstand wraps around itself in a continuous brass metallic shell — straight grain, warm, curving from back to front without a hard edge in sight. Above, a circle of matte silver grey travertine sits flush at the top, cool against the warmth of the metal. Two drawer fronts in dark grey matte elm veneer slide between the brass panels, the grain of the wood swirling naturally across each face. Inside, smoky melamine lines every drawer.

products.name: Delvane
products.shortDescription:
Two brass columns run the full height- slim, upright, their metallic finish warming the whole composition. From them, five shelves extend outward in dark grey matte elm veneer, each one slightly oversized, their rounded corners softening what could have been a purely industrial structure. The shelves float at equal intervals, open on all sides, the grain of the wood consistent across every level.

A bookcase that brings depth to a room without closing it in.

products.name: Cadren
products.shortDescription:
The Cadren is built around contrast. A straight grain brass metallic body forms the outer frame and shelves — warm, consistent, the grain running horizontally across every surface. Against it, dark back panels recede into each bay, creating depth that makes the whole unit read as something far more considered than a bookcase. Steel connecting parts in matte grey gold tie the structure together at the joints, visible enough to feel intentional.

Ten bays, endless arrangements. A bookcase that works as a room divider just as naturally as it does against a wall.

products.name: Gradven
products.shortDescription: Lean and upright, the Gradven shelving unit is all frame. A brushed bronze stainless steel structure rises from a brass metallic base, four open shelves ascending between two vertical rails, a handle bar crowning the top. The lower section closes into a solid panel. Nothing hidden, nothing excess.

products.name: Vaulne
products.shortDescription: Two dark arched columns rise from the base- elm veneer in deep grey matte, their tops curving to a point like doorways left open. Between them and beyond them, five oval shelves in brass metallic paint extend outward on both sides, their rounded ends floating past the uprights without support. The contrast is deliberate: dark and warm, structured and open.

products.name: Colven
products.shortDescription:
Five shelves, three brass columns. The Colven bookcase is organised around its verticals — brass metallic dividers running the full height of the piece, their ribbed surface catching the light between each bay. The shelves and back panel are wrapped in light grey elm veneer, the grain consistent and calm, letting the brass do the talking. The base and top cap round softly at the corners, giving the whole unit a considered finish that most bookcases never bother with.

A bookcase that looks as good empty as it does full.

products.name: Velor
products.shortDescription: Stripped back to its essentials, the Velor is a coat stand that earns its place in a room. Two oval frames sit one above the other on a single slender stem — the upper for hanging, the lower a quiet shelf — finished throughout in matte grey powder-coated metal. Between them, a panel of silver travertine in matte finish adds an unexpected moment of stone in an otherwise architectural form.

products.name: Taris
products.shortDescription: Grid-like in structure, warm in character. The Taris shelving unit is built from a repeat of vertical columns and horizontal shelves, all wrapped continuously in Techno Black walnut veneer — the grain running through every surface without interruption. No metal, no contrast finish. Just wood, in every direction. From across the room it reads as geometry. Up close, it’s all texture.

products.name: Kelmor
products.shortDescription:
Tall, open, and unhurried. The Kelmor shelving unit is all frame — a rounded rectangular outline in brass metallic that holds five evenly spaced shelves, each panel finished in the same warm brass tone. The base frame sits in black matt, grounding the piece without competing with it. Nothing is hidden. Everything is considered.
A shelving unit that works as hard as it looks good — equally at home in a study, a dressing room, or beside a bed.

products.name: Abrasse
products.shortDescription: The headboard does everything. Two generous arms sweep outward from the centre — broad, rounded, upholstered in a deep chocolate brown fabric that reads almost like suede from across the room. They curve forward slightly, wrapping the bed in a form that feels less like furniture and more like an embrace. The base sits low and clean beneath, covered in black velvet, raised on a black matte stainless steel frame that keeps the whole composition feeling considered rather than heavy.

products.name: Arcvelle
products.shortDescription:
Three curved fins rise from the base and wrap around the form — brushed brass lacquer, each one broad and confident, their edges rounding softly at the top. Between them, two circles of Candaglia marble sit one above the other: a lower shelf and a top surface, the stone warm white with a resin fill that smooths every natural void. The matte lacquer backplane panels sit quietly behind, letting the brass and marble do the talking.

A side table that works as hard from across the room as it does up close.

products.name: Galettre
products.shortDescription:
Three rounded forms cluster at the base — smooth, swelling, finished in a brushed brass lacquer that gives them the quality of something worn by water over time. Together they support a circle of matte Candaglia marble above, warm white and quietly veined, its surface soft to the touch. A black matte connecting plate ties the base together invisibly beneath.

The kind of side table that prompts a question every time someone sees it for the first time.

products.name: Fondre Rotonde
products.shortDescription: The same organic language as the Fondre, resolved into a perfect circle. A lobed fiberglass base rises and narrows before opening into a round MDF top — the whole piece finished in a single warm grey high-gloss lacquer, uninterrupted from base to surface. Where the Fondre is raw and textured in character, the Fondre Rotonde is polished and precise. The gloss finish amplifies every curve, every shadow, every subtle shift in the form.

products.name: Fondre
products.shortDescription:
The Fondre arrives as a single uninterrupted form — no legs, no joints, no assembly. A solid fiberglass body rises from a lobed base, its curves tapering inward before flattening at the top into a surface just wide enough to be useful. The vintage brass finish deepens at the recesses, catching more light at the crown. Organic without being shapeless. Sculptural without trying.

As comfortable beside a sofa as it is standing alone.

products.name: Torvenne
products.shortDescription: The Torvenne side table is built around a single curved panel of light grey elm veneer. The grain running vertically, the form wrapping into a cylinder that feels almost architectural. A leathered maple brown marble top sits above, its surface textured rather than polished, warm in tone with the kind of natural marking that makes each piece its own. A grey lacquered base plate anchors it all to the floor.

products.name: Bolvane
products.shortDescription: The Bolvane stops you mid-conversation. Two travertine spheres — silver grey, matte, perfectly round — sit between the top and the base, doing the work of legs while looking like nothing of the sort. Above them, a rectangular top in light grey elm veneer, the grain quiet and consistent. Below, a brushed brass lacquer base plate runs the full length, grounding the whole composition with a warm metallic edge.

products.name: Olmène
products.shortDescription:
Three tables, one family. The Olmène set arranges itself like a landscape — each piece a different height, a different scale, their organic tops shaped with the same unhurried hand. Above, slabs of Fendi green marble in matte finish: white stone crossed with grey-green veining, each top uniquely marked. Below, cylindrical drum bases wrapped in light grey elm veneer, the grain running consistently across every surface.

Together they fill a space naturally. Separately, each one holds its own.

products.name: Graven
products.shortDescription: The Graven looks like it was found rather than made. Both pieces- a low wide table and a taller companion, are wrapped continuously in silver grey travertine, matte in finish, the stone running from top to leg without interruption. The corners round softly, the proportions are generous, and the overall effect is one of something ancient made current. Use them together or apart. The stone does the work either way.

products.name: Verdenne
products.shortDescription: Two tables, one composition. The Verdenne nesting coffee tables are shaped with the same organic hand — their tops cut in soft irregular forms, each surface a slab of Naqiu green marble, its veining dark and deliberate. The legs beneath are brushed brass lacquer iron, the finish warm and slightly aged, standing in panels that curve at the edges like folded metal.

products.name: Travin
products.shortDescription:
Low to the ground and generous in presence, the Travin carries the kind of quiet weight that makes a room feel settled. Its high-gloss lacquered body rounds softly at every edge — nothing sharp, nothing hurried. The marble surface sits inset at the centre, its silver-grey tones shifting with the light, each marking unique to the stone it came from.

A table that does not announce itself. It simply belongs.

products.name: Dorval
products.shortDescription:
Round and unhurried, the Dorval draws the eye downward before it draws it up. The base rises in a single sculptural form- waisted, solid, finished in a two-tone brass lacquer that catches light differently depending on where you stand. Above it, a full circle of Croatian beige marble sits matte and still. Warm in tone, quiet in texture. The kind of surface that makes a room feel considered.

A piece that anchors without effort.

products.name: Sylven
products.shortDescription: The Sylven arrives like something grown rather than made. Its base rises in three organic columns — swelling at the foot, narrowing at the waist, merging seamlessly into a single form beneath the top. Finished in a deep olive high-gloss lacquer, it has the stillness of old bark and the confidence of ancient wood. Above, a full circle of Natuche green marble completes the picture — its veining dark and dramatic, every marking its own.

products.name: Arvik
products.shortDescription: Arvik draws its console on a single sweeping line. The top is a slim, softly tapered plane in light grey elm veneer, its fine grain running the full 160 cm. Beneath, two brass metallic bands curve and cross like ribbons caught mid-turn, meeting at the centre in an open weave that lets light and floor show through. The effect is more sculpture than support — architectural from the front, sinuous from the side. Slender in depth and expressive in profile, it makes an entrance hall or a long wall feel deliberate.

products.name: Clavène
products.shortDescription:
The legs make the table. Four sculpted blocks, two per pedestal, each one notched at the centre, creating a negative space that gives the whole base a sense of weight and lightness at once. Finished in a dual grey tone, they sit beneath a generous rectangular top of matte Fendi Snow White marble: white, calm, its faint grey veining barely there until the light shifts.

A dining table for those who look twice at everything.

products.name: Lamese Rotonde
products.shortDescription: The same architectural language as the Lamese, distilled into a single form. One arched pedestal — brass blades rising together and curving at the top — supports a full circle of matte sapphire marble above. The stone is extraordinary: grey and cream swept through with deep rust, every vein crossing the surface differently. No two tops alike.

products.name: Lamese
products.shortDescription: The base tells the story. Two pedestals, each built from a cluster of vertical brass blades — narrow, upright, their edges catching the light at different angles as you move around the table. The effect is architectural without being cold. Above them, a generous rectangular top in matte Naqiu green marble: deep, dark, its white veining crossing the surface like fault lines in stone.

products.name: Fervel
products.shortDescription:
Two bases, one table. The Fervel dining table is built around contrast -a pair of sculpted pedestals, each finished differently, standing side by side beneath a single sweeping oval of leathered Maple Brown marble. One leg in dual-tone brass, the other in dark grey elm veneer. Together they read as a composition rather than a structure. Warm against cool. Metallic against wood.

The marble surface carries its own quiet drama- leathered rather than polished, so the texture holds the light rather than reflecting it. Run a hand across it and the stone feels like something lived in rather than pristine.

A table that rewards a second look. And a third.

products.name: Ashven Sedia
products.shortDescription:
Honest in its construction. The Ashven Sedia dining chair puts the frame on show — ash wood legs in a dark grey matte elm veneer, the structure visible from every angle, cross-braced at the base with the kind of joinery that rewards a closer look. The seat and backrest float above it in a warm grey woven fabric, each panel cleanly cut and generously padded. Nothing ornate. Nothing unnecessary.

A chair that holds its own at any table.

products.name: Ashven
products.shortDescription:
Honest in its construction. The Ashven bar stool puts the frame on show — ash wood legs in a dark grey matte elm veneer, the structure visible from every angle, cross-braced at the base with the kind of joinery that rewards a closer look. The seat and backrest float above it in a warm grey woven fabric, each panel cleanly cut and generously padded. Nothing ornate. Nothing unnecessary.

A bar stool that earns its place at any counter.

products.name: Wovren
products.shortDescription: The Wovren is a chair you notice for its fabric first. A warm, multi-tone boucle weave covers every surface- seat and back without interruption — its threads catching the light in ways that shift depending on where you stand. Cream, sand, and the faintest flecks of colour woven through. The silhouette is simple: a rounded barrel back that curves over a full cylindrical seat, the whole form generous without being oversized. A matt black swivel base sits beneath.

products.name: Sevrenne
products.shortDescription:
The Sevrenne is a sofa that knows exactly what it is. Three generous sections sit side by side, each one deep and unhurried, upholstered throughout in a warm taupe faux leather that softens with the light. The arms curve inward at the top rounded, almost protective and the cushions are full without being casual. A slim black gold stainless steel base runs beneath the whole piece, barely visible, lifting it just off the floor with quiet precision.

A sofa you settle into without thinking twice

products.name: Lunève
products.shortDescription:
The Lunève draws you in before you sit down. Its crescent form curves gently outward- three sections that flow into one another without a hard edge in sight. The fabric is soft and close in tone, an oatmeal warmth that makes the whole piece feel like it belongs in morning light. A single round cushion sits at the centre, almost as punctuation. The dark grey plinth base keeps it grounded, lifting the silhouette just enough to feel considered.

A sofa that is very hard to leave.

products.name: Rondel
products.shortDescription:
Small in footprint, considered in every detail. The Rondel is a cylindrical stool that carries itself with quiet confidence — the body fully upholstered in a dusty steel blue fabric, its edge finished with a contrast trim that traces the silhouette like a tailor’s detail. The back rises just enough to suggest support without committing to a chair. A swivel base sits beneath, practical without announcing itself.

The kind of piece that fills a corner perfectly. Or the space beside a bed. Or anywhere a room needs one more considered moment.

products.name: Orbène
products.shortDescription:
Round in every sense. The Orbène swivel chair wraps around you in a single continuous curve, the back rising generously, the seat wide and deep, the whole form upholstered in a rich forest green fabric that gives the piece an almost velvet-like presence from across the room. Two cushions lean against the back, a round one rests at the centre.

Beneath it all, a black matte swivel base turns the chair into something almost playful.

products.name: Nimbus
products.shortDescription:
Some sofas furnish a room. The Nimbus transforms it.
Inspired by the effortless poetry of clouds in motion, the Nimbus is defined by its breathtaking backrest- a continuous wave of softly billowing peaks that rise and fall across the full width of the sofa like a sculptural horizon. No two silhouettes are the same from any angle, making this a piece that rewards every glance.
Three generous seat cushions flow seamlessly below, their deep, rounded forms grounded and inviting, while two small cylindrical bolster arms tuck in at either end with a charming, considered gentleness. Every surface is wrapped in a sumptuously textured fabric in the softest oyster white – its subtle, cloud-like weave catching light with a quiet luminosity that feels as pure as the form itself.
The Nimbus doesn’t ask to be the centrepiece of a room. It simply becomes one, naturally.

products.name: Wexor
products.shortDescription: Wexor is a full-length mirror with a drawing on its surface. Fine etched lines meander down the glass like the grain of split stone or a river seen from above — visible at an angle, almost invisible head-on, so the piece reads as pure reflection from across the room and as artwork up close. A slim brass-plated stainless steel frame holds it with the minimum of ceremony, and a matte black backboard keeps the profile crisp at just 4 cm. Two metres tall and made to lean or hang, it turns a dressing area or a bare wall into something considered.

products.name: Oxler
products.shortDescription:
Oxler is a study in confident restraint – a sofa that commands attention not through ornamentation, but through the sheer precision of its form.

Its most arresting feature is the seamlessly wrapped frame that sweeps from arm to arm in one unbroken, architectural gesture – thick, bold, and beautifully upholstered from every angle. The deep, cloud-soft seat sits within this sculptural embrace like a quiet luxury waiting to be discovered, while the low, clean profile gives the Oxler a grounded, gallery-worthy presence that works effortlessly in both contemporary and transitional interiors.

Upholstered entirely in a sumptuously tactile fabric- its bouclé-like texture adding warmth and visual depth- every surface invites touch as much as admiration. Resting on a refined base with a gleaming champagne gold finish, the Oxler balances architectural boldness with a softness that is entirely its own.

A sofa that doesn’t just fill a room- it defines it.

Four panels of dark grey matte elm veneer wrap the full width of the body, their grain running vertically in a rhythm that gives the piece an almost architectural quality — like a row of columns, close together, in deep shadow. A 5mm ceramic top sits above, cool and precise. Beneath, a brass metallic base frame curves into an arch at the centre, lifting the whole piece with a warm metallic flourish that contrasts quietly with the darkness above.

products.name: Perlon
products.shortDescription: The Perlon nightstand wears its materials as a band. A wide ring of brass metallic straight grain paint wraps the upper body — warm, linear, its finish catching light at different angles throughout the day. Below it, dark grey matte elm veneer lines the open lower shelf, the grain deep and consistent. The drawer front carries the same brass metallic tone as the upper band, tying the two halves together without closing the piece off.

products.name: Ostrel
products.shortDescription:
The Ostrel is defined by its columns. A row of rounded vertical forms — each one wrapped in warm man-made walnut veneer, their grain running consistently from top to base — stand side by side across the full width of the piece. Above them, a white jade stone top sits cool and flat, its pale tone a composed contrast to the richness of the wood beneath.

A counter that brings the warmth of a library to any room it enters.

products.name: Norven
products.shortDescription:
The Norven sideboard is a composition in three materials. The upper body runs in brass metallic straight grain — warm, linear, its surface topped with a slim glass panel that adds depth without weight. To the right, a section clad in matte silver grey travertine brings stone into the structure, its natural veining a quiet counterpoint to the precision of the metalwork. To the left and below, dark grey matte elm veneer grounds the whole piece, its grain deep and consistent across every panel and door.

Open bays, closed drawers, and a form that works as hard as it looks considered.

products.name: Mirel
products.shortDescription: The Mirel counter table is wrapped in a continuous brass metallic shell — straight grain, warm, curving around the body from back to front without interruption. A circle of matte silver grey travertine caps the top, cool and still against the warmth of the metal. Below, two drawer fronts and a mid-level shelf panel are finished in dark grey matte elm veneer, the grain deep and consistent across every face. Inside, smoky melamine lines each drawer with the same quiet care.

Mirel — Desks by Maison Debrah

products.name: Lavor
products.shortDescription:
The Lavor console is all about the base. A single solid form in brass metallic rounded at every corner, hollowed at the centre into a wide arch- sits beneath a dark oak veneer top that stretches clean and flat from edge to edge. The contrast is quiet but deliberate: the warmth of the brass against the deep matte of the wood, the organic softness of the base against the precision of the top.

A console that earns its place in any entrance.

products.name: Frevon
products.shortDescription: Frevon is built on a single, confident cone. A perfect circle of dark elm veneer forms the top, its fine grain reading close to charcoal until light draws the warmth back out of it. The pedestal beneath tapers downward in the same smoked timber, then meets the floor in a broad collar of silver travertine — a diagonal cut that gives the base its quiet tension, stone grounding wood the way a plinth grounds a sculpture. Round, pedestal-based and free of legs, it seats four to six in easy conversation and works as well in a compact dining room as in the corner of an open plan.

products.name: Caldor
products.shortDescription:
The Caldor is a study in warmth. A free-form circle of rose gold marble sits above a cylindrical brushed brass stainless steel frame — the stone pale and softly veined with blush tones, the metal below it rich and luminous. A matte grey bottom plate grounds the base, the one cool note in an otherwise entirely warm composition.

Small in scale. Generous in presence.

products.name: Brisen
products.shortDescription: Brisen is a console built on contrast. The top is silver-grey travertine in a matte finish, its open, softly pitted grain reading almost like raw linen — cool, quiet, tactile. Framing it, the surround and the twin blade legs are lacquered in khaki high-gloss, a warm greige that catches the light where the stone refuses it. The legs are drawn as two slim vertical planes, one turned to reveal an open cut-out, giving a 140 cm span the impression of resting on air. A matte white underside keeps the piece composed from every angle. Slender in depth and generous in line, it settles into a hallway, a landing or behind a sofa without ever crowding the room.

A square top of matte Dover white marble sits above a vintage brass fiberglass pedestal — the stone pale and quietly veined, the base warm and aged in tone. The bottom panel in matte white completes the composition beneath, keeping the whole piece light despite its solid presence.

A softly squared top of silver-grey travertine sits above a leg cut into an open loop — one face left in the same matte stone, the other lacquered in khaki high-gloss, so the piece shifts between raw and refined as you move around it. The cut-out lightens what could have been a solid block, and the slim supporting plate underneath lifts it clear of the floor. Compact at 60 cm square and generous in height, it slips beside a sofa or a bed and holds a lamp, a book and a glass without asking for space it doesn’t need.

The glass is cut into a tall, softly rounded oval and set against panels of vintage brass, which surface at the edges in two irregular, cloud-like forms — one high, one low — so the reflection appears to float free of any frame. From a distance the piece reads as a piece of wall art in warm metal; step closer and it becomes an unbroken 180 cm mirror. Slim in profile at just over 4 cm deep, it leans or hangs equally well in a bedroom, dressing area or entrance hall.

products.shortDescription: Ardeno turns a mirror into a composition. The glass is cut as a generous, soft-cornered rectangle, its silvered surface interrupted at two opposite corners by curved panels of vintage brass — one sweeping in from the top right, the other rising from the lower left, like light falling across the frame. The effect is graphic from across the room and quietly functional up close, where a full 120 cm of clear reflection remains. Slim at just over 4 cm deep, it hangs in either orientation and brings warmth to a hallway, dressing room or above a console.

products.name: Brelis
products.shortDescription: Brelis frames its reflection in something closer to landscape than moulding. The mirror is cut as a soft, undulating form and set forward of two layered panels — an outer edge clad in matte Croatia beige marble, its rippling profile echoing the mirror’s own, and a slim inner band in dual-tone brass that glows where the light reaches it. The layering gives the piece real depth for its slender 4.5 cm section, and the irregular silhouette means no two viewing angles read quite the same. Organic, tactile and a little theatrical — a mirror that behaves like wall art when no one is looking into it.

products.name: Corven
products.shortDescription: Corven suspends its reflection inside a drawing. Slim rings of stainless steel in brushed bronze loop and overlap around a round mirror, each circle set at a slightly different angle so the piece reads as movement caught still — a line sketched in the air rather than a frame. The mirror itself floats at the centre, held by discreet white connectors, with the backing in matte beige keeping the composition soft against the wall. Graphic, weightless and only 5 cm deep, it brings light and geometry to a hallway, a bathroom or a quiet stretch of wall that needs a focal point.

The brushed brass stainless steel frame carries it all beneath, four legs meeting at a rectangular footrest that runs the full width. Practical in structure. Polished in finish.

products.name: Estrin
